name: Air Defender
author: G Hancox
description: Closes your moving heads' shutters while low aircraft fly near your show. Sends your show's location to adsb.fi (free flight data) to find aircraft nearby; only if you use them, to adsb.lol as a backup and to Open-Meteo to look up your ground elevation.

privacy.summary: Checks adsb.fi, a free flight-tracking service, for low aircraft near your show and closes your moving heads' shutters while one is close. Your show's location is sent to adsb.fi.

sends.what: your show's location and search radius
sends.why: to get the aircraft near your show, only if you choose it, or turn on Use the other as a backup

sends.what: your show's location and search radius
sends.why: to get the aircraft flying near your show (the default service), only while Air Defender is checking

sends.to: http://your own ADS-B receiver on your network
sends.what: a request for the aircraft it hears (no location)
sends.why: to check for aircraft without the internet, if you choose it
to look up the ground elevation there, only when you press Look it up in Settings

sends.to: http://the master FPP on your network
sends.what: a request for its status, with the master's UI password if you enter one
sends.why: so a Remote closes its heads when the master does

collects.what: callsigns, distance and height of low aircraft that passed near your show

systemChanges.what: runs a background process while FPP is running, to watch for aircraft and control the shutters

privacy.other: While an aircraft is near, or during a test, it overrides the shutter channels of the moving heads you list using FPP's channel overlays. A read-only status page on FPP's web server lets Remote FPPs check the master. On a Remote, the master's UI password is kept in plugindata, readable only by the fpp user. adsb.lol is sent the location too only if you choose it or turn it on as a backup.
